domain: 车辆轨道结构与数值方法
definition_zh: 设置在轨枕与道床之间以调节支承和动力性能的弹性垫板。

complete_examples.text: The results demonstrated that by the use of grouting or under-sleeper pads, the stiffness variation along the track can be modified, and accordingly the wheel/rail contact force can be considerably reduced.
